__comment__: RTX Lidar config approximating the Livox Mid-360 for Isaac Sim 5.1.0.
The real Mid-360 is a non-repetitive solid-state scanner: 360 deg HFOV,
vertical FOV approx -7 to +52 deg, ~200k points/s, 10 Hz frame rate, range
0.1-40 m. A perfectly faithful non-repetitive rosette pattern is hard to
express here; this is a dense rotary approximation good enough for SLAM
(FAST-LIO2 / slam_toolbox) coverage. To use it, set LIDAR_CONFIG in
attach_sensors.py to the ABSOLUTE path of this file, or copy it next to
Isaac's built-in lidar configs and reference it by name.
Tune emitterStates/scanRate against the real /livox/lidar density before
name: Livox_Mid360_Approx
